The Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) provides geographical information on land cover and land use and their changes, ground motion, vegetation state, water cycle and Earth's surface energy variables for both Europe and the entire globe.<br>
CLMS is jointly implemented by the European Environment Agency and the European Commission DG Joint Research Centre (JRC) and has been operational since 2012.<br>
CLMS consists of several components.<br>

# CLMS Portfolio {#clms_portfolio}

:::{.callout-note}
## Disclaimer: CLMS Product Availability on CDSE
CLMS is in the process of onboarding its products to the CDSE. The migration process is expected to last until the end of 2025. Until the process is finalized, not all CLMS products will be available on the CDSE. Onboarded products will be added in section [CLMS Portfolio](#clms_portfolio).

For the complete CLMS data catalog, please consult [land.copernicus.eu](https://land.copernicus.eu/en){target='_blank'}.

We appreciate your understanding and patience as we work to integrate our full suite of products. For the most up-to-date information on product availability, please check back regularly or contact our support team.

Thank you for your continued support.

:::

CLMS products are accessible via the [S3 protocol](../../APIs/S3.html) and [OData](../../APIs/OData.html).<br>

The S3 Path is:

```
/eodata/CLMS/

```
To access data for a specific product, please use the S3 path or OData link provided in each section below.

constellation = "CLMStoCDSE"

## Disclaimer: CLMS Product Availability through CREODIAS Federation
The following products are made available through the CREODIAS federation and may contain significant differences regarding completeness, timeliness, format, and content as compared to the [CLMS portfolio](#clms_portfolio). These products **will be removed** once the CLMS migration process is finalized.

For more information on the official product portfolio and services, please consult [land.copernicus.eu](https://land.copernicus.eu/en){target='_blank'}.

We appreciate your understanding and patience during this transition period. For the most up-to-date information, please check back regularly or contact our support team.

Thank you for your continued support.

:::
